@m0saic/wireframe/base/v3.label: Wireframe
@m0saic/wireframe/base/v3.description: Wireframe of any m0 layout string: every cell drawn as an outlined rectangle with its number, pixel size and aspect ratio on a white canvas. Switch the background to transparent to composite over anything or trace a reference screenshot, or pick the thumb, heatmap or paper presets for clean tiles.

M0String.label: Mosaic Layout String
M0String.description: m0 string to generate layout of

labels.label: Cell Labels
labels.description: Optional labels for wireframe cells (1-based order). A labeled cell shows its label; cells without one keep their number and pixel size (see Label Content / Unlabeled Cells).

unlabeledCells.label: Unlabeled Cells
unlabeledCells.description: What a cell without a custom label shows once some cells are labeled: "marks" (default — its number / dims per Label Content) or "empty" (blank — labels are the only text on the board).

labelsByStableKey.label: Labels by stableKey
labelsByStableKey.description: Per-cell labels keyed by stableKey (Record<StableKey, {text, color?}>, same shape as M0cFile.labels). Resolved to positional labels internally; overrides `labels`. Agent/programmatic prop.

cellColors.label: Cell Colors
cellColors.description: Optional per-cell body fill colors (1-based order, parallel to labels). Cell N's body is painted cellColors[N-1] beneath the border/label ink; an empty string leaves it transparent. Used by the perf heatmap. Debug mode only.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Render mode. "debug" (default) shows numbers/dims/AR. "thumb" shows clean tiles only.

labelContent.label: Label Content
labelContent.description: Most detail to show per tile (cumulative): none → number → dimensions → aspect. Default dimensions.

labelOverflow.label: Label Overflow
labelOverflow.description: How to back off when the content won't fit a tile: hide (all-or-nothing), degrade (drop richest lines), number-floor (fall back to just the number). Default degrade.

background.label: Background
background.description: Canvas backing: "white" (default — an opaque white fill) or "transparent" (lines/labels only, null regions empty — composites over anything). Ignored when a theme/preset sets its own background.

nullFrames.label: Null Frames
nullFrames.description: Dev: "show" explodes the layout into LAYERS — one PNG per overlay depth (emit:multi), each printing that depth's cells plus its null (-) holes as dashed, muted cells labelled "null" + size. "hide" (default) renders the normal single composite.

nullLabel.label: Null Label
nullLabel.description: Dev: the text drawn inside a hole cell when null frames show — the word "null" (default) or the m0 token "-".

fill.label: Rect Fill
fill.description: Translucent rect fill (debug mode), 0..1. Body wash beneath the borders/labels so rects read as filled regions over a traced image. 0 = lines only.

backgroundImage.label: Background Image
backgroundImage.description: Image baked beneath the wireframe — lines/labels render on top. A file path or an inline base64 data: URI. Drop a reference screenshot here to trace a layout over it.

backgroundImageFit.label: Background Image Fit
backgroundImageFit.description: How the background image fills the canvas: "cover" (default, fill + crop) or "contain" (letterbox, pad reveals the canvas background).

preset.label: Preset
preset.description: Named theme preset. Sets mode, colors, borders, and effects. Explicit mode/theme override preset values.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Theme overrides applied on top of preset defaults. Colors, borders, rounding, shadows.
